properties.name: Clay-bearing outcrop
properties.why: Clay minerals form in the presence of water and can preserve traces of it.
properties.photo_caption: Example from Jezero: rock slabs at "Jigging Cove", where Perseverance searched for clay-bearing rocks.

properties.name: Delta front layers
properties.why: Tilted layers of sand and mud laid down where a river entered the lake show where and how the water moved.
properties.photo_caption: Example from Jezero: Kodiak, a butte of layered rock left from the river delta.

properties.name: Carbonate margin
properties.why: Carbonates form when carbon-dioxide-rich water reacts with rock and can trap evidence of past conditions.
properties.photo_caption: Example from Jezero: a rock core drilled in the Margin Unit, which NASA says may contain carbonate minerals.
